name: Lenia on the hat
description: The Orbium parameters (R=13, T=10, b=1, m=0.15, s=0.015) on a patch of about 35,000 hat tiles, from a dense random blob. Lenia's kernel uses straight-line distances between tile centres in units of the mean tile size, so it runs on aperiodic tilings too; here the blob breaks up into worms and dots.
